site_api._entry_stage_note: Each live card carries the firm's own round label ('Seed in 2015', 'Series A 2016', 'Secondary 2021'). Eligible by semantics (the firm's claim about the round IT entered, beside the year); it labels (entry_stage_fields: ['stage_site']) only after it is scored blind against the book's documented rounds (decisions.md D10). Bare years ('2008') and 'Initial investment' / 'Investment' name no round and stay anchors.
site_api._note: balderton.com is WordPress (AIOSEO, FacetWP). The company and team_member post types are hidden from the REST API and the sitemaps, so both lists are read off the rendered pages: /companies/?_paged=1..9 (205 cards, escalation ladder step 5) and /team/ (48 cards with the site's own group classes). Per-person pages carry LinkedIn and X links, read by site-portfolio.py. The news archive (552 posts 2007, 2014-2026; 385 portfolio news) is the fourth surface (sources/site/news-raw/).
site_api._entry_stage_score: Scored 2026-09-26 at the taxonomy level (Pre-Seed / Seed / Series A / Growth) against dated announcements that name the round: the firm's own news posts published within a year of the card's year (84 rows with a round word: 80 agree, 4 miss) and TechCrunch's own archive as the independent sample (14 rows with a round word: 13 agree, the miss is Carwow again). Union 92 rows, 88 agree = 95.7%; the first batch of the grind then found three more documented misses (MySQL: Series B 2003, not Series A 2001; Sketchfab: the 2013 round was the seed; Vivino: the 2013 round was the Series A, not a Series C), so 88 of 95 = 92.6% and the field labels at medium (COLLECTION.md s5: high needs >=95% over >=30). The final score is restated in report.md. All four misses are one class, a card reading 'Series A' where the record names another round: Carwow (Balderton led the GBP 1.3M seed, 2014-02), Furhat Robotics (seed, 2017-09), Crowdcube (Series B, 2014-07), Detectify (Series B, 2019-11). A documented round overrides the card with stage_disputes_band. Sub-labels inside Growth differ without changing the stage (Sophia Genetics: card Series B, TechCrunch Series D; Talend: card Series D, TechCrunch Series C). scratch/stage-score-techcrunch.json holds the press sample.
